data.name: Gnomes Garden 3: The thief of castles
data.detailed_description:
"The gnome princess has finally come home. She managed to make peace with the trolls and befriend their queen, but at home evil was afoot: a warlock collector stole the gnome monarch’s castle along with the royal family! The princess must gather a team and set off on a new adventure to save her loved ones!

Set off with her through uncharted lands full of mystery and unbelievable creatures in the exciting casual fantasy/strategy game Gnomes Garden 3.

Lots of different objectives, more than 40 levels, a fun plot, simple and engrossing gameplay, and new game elements: all this and more awaits in a special magical world. Manage resources and building construction, plant magic giant trees, and fight against the dastardly warlock and his mass of followers. Simple gameplay and concise insructions will help you dive right in. Just don’t forget about the princess’ immense magical power if you get stuck!

Gnomes Garden 3 — track the evil warlock to the Grey Wastelands!

- An extraordinary magical world whose source of magic is ancient gardens.
- An upbeat plot, colorful comics and charming characters!
- A multitude of varied quests and new gameplay elements.
- Colorful trophies.
- Over 40 unique levels.
- Unusual enemies: sentient plants, gremlins, stone dormice and... krakens.
- 4 unique locations: the magic forest, crystal caves, desert and Grey Wastelands.
- Useful bonuses: speed up work, stop time, run fast.
- Simple controls and a well-designed tutorial..
- Over 20 hours of exciting gameplay for all ages.
- Pleasant themed music."

reviews.review:
Gnomes Garden 3: The Thief of Castles continues the lighthearted fantasy strategy series with another charming adventure centered on resource management, quick decision-making, and colorful storytelling. Developed by Creobit and published by 8Floor, the game places players in the role of the determined gnome princess whose peaceful kingdom is thrown into chaos when a mysterious collector of magical artifacts steals the royal castle along with her family. This unusual premise immediately sets the stage for a rescue mission that spans a variety of magical landscapes filled with obstacles, strange creatures, and hidden dangers.

At its core, the game follows the familiar time-management formula that the series is known for. Players gather resources such as food, wood, stone, and crystals while repairing roads, rebuilding structures, and overcoming environmental barriers. Every level presents a series of objectives that must be completed efficiently, often requiring careful prioritization of tasks and thoughtful allocation of resources. While the controls remain simple and accessible, later stages introduce enough complexity to keep players engaged as they strive for the best possible completion times and star ratings.

One of the game's biggest strengths is the variety found throughout its campaign. The adventure stretches across more than forty levels spread among several distinct regions, including enchanted forests, crystal-filled caverns, arid deserts, and bleak wastelands. Each environment introduces unique visual themes and gameplay challenges that help maintain a sense of progression. New mechanics, buildings, and obstacles appear regularly, ensuring that players are continually adapting their strategies rather than repeating the same solutions from earlier stages.

The fantasy world itself is imaginative and inviting. Ancient magical gardens power the kingdom, and players encounter a range of whimsical inhabitants and adversaries along the journey. Gremlins, stone creatures, magical beasts, and other unusual enemies add personality to the maps without turning the experience into a combat-focused strategy game. Instead, success comes from efficient planning and resource optimization, which perfectly suits the game's relaxed but engaging design philosophy. The narrative remains simple, yet it effectively ties the levels together and provides a clear motivation for the princess's quest.

Visually, Gnomes Garden 3 embraces a colorful cartoon presentation that complements its family-friendly atmosphere. The environments are bright and easy to navigate, making it simple to identify resources, pathways, and objectives at a glance. Character animations are modest but appealing, and the overall art direction gives the game a cheerful identity. Accompanying the visuals is a pleasant soundtrack that supports the fantasy setting without becoming distracting, helping create a relaxing experience that can be enjoyed in short sessions or longer playthroughs.

The strategic depth may surprise some players. Although the mechanics appear straightforward at first, later levels demand careful planning and efficient use of upgrades. Production buildings can be improved to increase output, and understanding the most effective order of actions becomes crucial for earning top ratings. This gradual increase in challenge rewards players who enjoy optimizing routes and finding more efficient solutions. The balance between accessibility and strategy is one of the game's strongest achievements.

The game is not entirely free of flaws. Veterans of the time-management genre may find certain objectives repetitive after extended play sessions, and the story itself does not evolve much beyond its basic rescue narrative. Some levels can also feel restrictive when pursuing perfect scores, requiring a degree of trial and error to discover the most efficient approach. However, these shortcomings are relatively minor and do little to diminish the overall enjoyment offered by the campaign.

Gnomes Garden 3: The Thief of Castles succeeds as a charming and entertaining strategy adventure that delivers exactly what fans of the genre expect. Its combination of resource management, level variety, colorful visuals, and approachable gameplay creates a satisfying experience suitable for both newcomers and returning players. While it may not reinvent the formula, it refines it effectively and provides many hours of enjoyable fantasy-themed challenges. For players seeking a relaxing yet rewarding time-management game, this installment stands as one of the stronger entries in the series.

Rating: 8/10
